fields.description: SAMANA Imperial Garden is an apartment development in Arjan, with studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom homes. Its layouts include selected private pools and flexible partitions; the published one-bedroom Type 7 has no pool.

research.locationNote: Arjan, Dubai. Pool provision depends on the chosen layout.
overview: The official drawings show two studio types, seven one-bedroom types and a two-bedroom layout. Flexible partitions do not establish an additional approved bedroom category.
research.priceNote: Developer advertised reference: AED 980,000; current availability requires confirmation. Property Finder records an AED 994,444 launch reference.
research.handoverNote: Developer FAQ: Q1 2029. Property Finder: December 2028. These conflicting targets do not confirm completion.
research.paymentNote: PDC: 15% booking + 10% in month 12 + 75 monthly payments of 1%. Non-PDC: 20% + 10% in month 12 + 70 monthly payments of 1%. Each totals 100%; confirm contractual eligibility.
